Use the **workflow icon** (two connected squares) consistently in the ribbon, view tab and planner heading. The README now names **Máquina**, my AI assistant, in the story of the experiment.

Requires Obsidian 1.10.2 or later. Install or update using `main.js`, `manifest.json` and `styles.css` from the assets below. Copy them directly into your vault's configuration directory under `plugins/just-simple-planner/`, then reload the plugin.

Validation: official Obsidian lint rules, strict TypeScript, fourteen model tests, build and package audit, central installation verification, and an in-app check of the three icon locations in `@Nexus-dev`.
